Third-party notices
===================

SVGAPlayer-SVG 1.0.0
Source: https://github.com/PonyCui/SVGAPlayer-SVG
License: ISC, as declared by the upstream package.json.
Copyright: upstream contributors.

The bundled browser converter is based on the upstream browser build and is
used locally to transform SVGA 2.x files into animated SVG documents.

Jimp 0.6.3
Source: https://github.com/jimp-dev/jimp
License: MIT. The minified bundle also retains its upstream license banner.

libpag 4.5.81
Source: https://github.com/Tencent/libpag
License: Apache-2.0 with third-party notices in the upstream LICENSE.txt.
The pinned official JavaScript and WebAssembly runtime is bundled locally.
The complete upstream license is included as libpag-LICENSE.txt.
Selected PAG files remain in the browser and are not uploaded by this tool.
